summary: Owned the training, model registry, scanning and deployment services inside ForgeML.
description: Cut model deployment from 3 days to 30 minutes for 15+ data scientists by building multi-target deployment orchestration across Databricks Serving, AKS and edge devices.
Designed ForgeML as 8 microservices exposing 30+ FastAPI endpoints, covering training, model registry, security scanning, deployment and monitoring for multi-tenant workloads.
Fine-tuned Gemini on Vertex AI to translate SkySpark Axon rules into Honeywell Forge DSL, reaching 80%+ accuracy, with job submission and status polling handled automatically.
Halved write latency on an Azure Event Hub pipeline by writing to PostgreSQL and Unity Catalog concurrently, with exactly-once delivery backed by Blob Storage checkpoints.
Caught 40+ vulnerabilities before deployment by putting 5 security scanners behind a Strategy Pattern, alongside JWT RS256 auth and OPA policy enforcement.
Built a BDD acceptance suite in Behave covering onboarding through deployment, running in parallel across tenants, with Locust load tests alongside it.

summary: Built the Databricks pipelines behind field service analytics and the Maintenance Assist chatbot.
description: Built 15+ PySpark ingestion pipelines on Databricks pulling from SQL Server, Salesforce, SharePoint and REST APIs into Delta Lake, with watermark-based incremental loading.
Engineered a Spark Structured Streaming pipeline for PDFs landing in Blob Storage, applying SCD Type 2 upserts so document changes stayed traceable across micro-batches.
Built the document vectorization pipeline into PGVector behind the Maintenance Assist chatbot, plus an evaluation harness that scored answers with Azure OpenAI as judge.
Kept the serving database in sync using batched Delta to PostgreSQL upserts with ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE, which removed the need for full table reloads.
Wired Change Data Feed on Delta tables so downstream vectorization jobs fired on incremental inserts, updates and deletes rather than on a schedule.
Wrote the SQL transformation pipelines producing weekly, monthly and quarterly field service analytics for the customer-facing DSP dashboard.
